neighbours.label: the token 'Robert' (strongest as the first word of a new line)
fire:
The program ended last spring.
Robert Hale, head of the parks office, said it would return.
According to the report, Robert Chen led the survey team.
Last week a reader named Robert wrote to us about the bridge.
The award went to Robert Lowe for his work on rivers.

We spoke with the coach.
Robert Diaz has trained runners for twenty years.
In the letter, Robert asked his sister to visit.
The band was founded by Robert and two friends.

Thanks to everyone who came.
Robert Ellis, festival organizer
